content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble using [product_name] V7 on Mac OS X 10.7 (the software crashes when I try to transfer data from the device to my Mac). Is it possible that the software isn't compatible with this OS X version? Does anyone know more about this?
Hello, According to the documentation, it's compatible only up to Mac OS X 10.5. For which operating systems is [product_name] released? Regards,
Hi, Supported versions include: MacOS 4 with J2Se1.5.0 and Mac OS 10.5 with J2SE 1.6.0.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering crashes when transferring data between [product_name] and Macs running OS X 10.7. There is confusion about compatibility on newer versions of MacOS, and users learn that official support only goes up to OS X 10.5. This creates a barrier for those with updated Macs, leaving them without clear instructions for newer systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] V7 to work and be compatible with Mac OS X 10.7, especially for transferring data from associated hardware.
